unitTitle: The Python Hunt - Episode 2: Face-to-face Encounter
scanNote:
HIKOYa - 'THE PYTHON HUNT', 2-EPIZOD 'Face-to-face Encounter' (88-bet). KOMIKS, 7 kadr.

Yuqorida chapda KO'K yorliq: kasseta belgisi, 'Episode 2', 'Face-to-face Encounter'. Sariq sarlavha 'The Python Hunt'.

QAHRAMONLAR: Sandra (sariq sochli ayol), David (qora sochli, sariq ko'ylak, kamerali), Adamou (mahalliy ovchi, oq ko'ylak, soqolli - ilon iniga kiradi), Abou (yosh mahalliy yigit, yalang'och ko'krak).

1-KADR: Sandra Davidning ustiga egilgan, David yerda yotibdi, kamerani ushlab. Abou orqada. Sandra: 'Are you all right, David?' David: 'Yes ... I wasn't hurt, I was just very frightened! The python tried to bite me, but it hit my camera. What a huge snake!'
2-KADR: Adamou yonayotgan somon bilan inga kirmoqda, Abou va David qaramoqda. Abou: 'The snake has been disturbed. It will be more dangerous to catch it now.' David: 'I wouldn't go back into that hole if you paid me!'
3-KADR: In ichida Adamou yonayotgan somon bilan, oldida katta ilon boshi. Abou (kadr ustida): 'If my father is lucky, the burning straw will stop the snake from attacking. He'll try to catch it and pull it out by its tail.'
4-KADR: Sandra va Abou; o'ylash pufagida Adamou in ichida ilonni ushlamoqda. Sandra: 'What's happening? Is Adamou all right?' Abou: 'If he wasn't all right, we would hear him shouting! Don't worry, Sandra, he's done this hundreds of times.'
5-KADR: Adamou inidan ilonning dumini tortib chiqmoqda, Abou dumni ushlab tortmoqda, Sandra yaqin, David orqada. Adamou: 'Now I must hold its head before it can attack ...' Sandra: 'Wow! It's enormous!' David: 'Move back, Sandra! Abou can't catch it if you stand there!'
6-KADR: Ilon bo'shab ketdi, Abou yiqilmoqda, Sandra orqaga qochmoqda. Abou: 'Oh, no!' David: 'Look out!'
7-KADR: Sandra va Abou, orqada ilon o'tlar orasiga ketmoqda. Sandra: 'I'm so sorry, Abou! Because of me, the python got away.' Abou: 'Never mind. The snake was lucky today - and WE'RE lucky, too, because nobody was hurt.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '88'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story. Episode 2: Face-to-face Encounter.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-EPIZODNI ESLANG (68-bet):
Sandra va David Afrikada piton
ovini suratga olmoqchi. Adamou
(ovchi) va o'g'li Abou bilan. David
ilon iniga juda yaqin bordi va
piton unga hujum qildi.


2-EPIZOD TARJIMASI:

1) Sandra: Yaxshimisan, David?
   David: Ha ... jarohat olmadim,
   faqat juda qo'rqdim! Piton meni
   tishlamoqchi bo'ldi, lekin
   kameramga urildi. Qanday ulkan
   ilon!

2) Abou: Ilon bezovta qilindi. Endi
   uni tutish xavfliroq bo'ladi.
   David: Pul bersangiz ham o'sha
   inga qaytib kirmasdim!

3) Abou: Agar otamning omadi kelsa,
   yonayotgan somon ilonning hujum
   qilishini to'xtatadi. U ilonni
   tutib, dumidan tortib chiqarishga
   harakat qiladi.

4) Sandra: Nima bo'lyapti? Adamou
   yaxshimi?
   Abou: Agar u yaxshi bo'lmasa,
   qichqirganini eshitardik!
   Tashvishlanma, Sandra, u buni
   yuzlab marta qilgan.

5) Adamou: Endi hujum qilishidan
   oldin boshini ushlashim kerak ...
   Sandra: Voy! U ulkan!
   David: Orqaga o'tir, Sandra! Sen
   u yerda tursang, Abou uni tuta
   olmaydi!

6) Abou: Voy, yo'q!
   David: Ehtiyot bo'l!

7) Sandra: Kechirasan, Abou! Men
   tufayli piton qochib ketdi.
   Abou: Hechqisi yo'q. Bugun
   ilonning omadi keldi - va BIZNING
   ham omadimiz keldi, chunki hech
   kim jarohat olmadi.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA - ShART GAPLARI:

  1-TUR (real):
  'If my father IS lucky, the straw
   WILL stop the snake.'
  'Abou CAN'T catch it if you STAND
   there.'

  2-TUR (xayoliy):
  'I WOULDN'T go back if you PAID
   me!'
  'If he WASN'T all right, we WOULD
   hear him shouting!'


⚠ 'FACE-TO-FACE':

  = yuzma-yuz.


⚠ 'AN ENCOUNTER':

  = uchrashuv (kutilmagan).


⚠ 'TO BE HURT':

  = jarohat olmoq.
  ⚠ hurt - hurt - hurt.


⚠ 'FRIGHTENED':

  = qo'rqqan.
  ⚠ 'frightening' = qo'rqinchli.


⚠ 'TO BITE':

  bit - bitten. = tishlamoq.


⚠ 'HUGE' = 'ENORMOUS':

  = ulkan.


⚠ 'TO DISTURB':

  = bezovta qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'has been disturbed' - passiv
  (1-epizod nomi 'Do not Disturb').


⚠ 'IF YOU PAID ME':

  = pul bersang ham (hech qachon).
  Idioma!


⚠ 'STRAW':

  = somon.


⚠ 'TO PULL OUT BY ITS TAIL':

  = dumidan tortib chiqarmoq.


⚠ 'HUNDREDS OF TIMES':

  = yuzlab marta.


⚠ 'TO MOVE BACK':

  = orqaga o'tmoq.


⚠ 'LOOK OUT!':

  = Ehtiyot bo'l! (xavf).


⚠ 'TO GET AWAY':

  = qochib ketmoq.


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = Hechqisi yo'q.


⚠ 'BECAUSE OF ME':

  = men tufayli.
  ⚠ 'because of' + OT.

exercises.instructionEn: Check your understanding of the episode.

items.textEn: 1 What happened to David when the python attacked?
items.uz: 1 Piton hujum qilganda Davidga nima bo'ldi?
options: He wasn't hurt, but he was very frightened.
items.answer: He wasn't hurt, but he was very frightened.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'I wasn't hurt, I was just very frightened!' - piton kameraga urildi.

items.textEn: 2 Why is it more dangerous to catch the snake now?
3 What will stop the snake from attacking Adamou?
items.uz: 3 Nima ilonning Adamouga hujum qilishini to'xtatadi?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'the burning straw will stop the snake from attacking'.

items.textEn: 4 How does Adamou pull the snake out of the hole?
5 Why does Abou say Adamou is all right?
items.uz: 5 Nega Abou Adamou yaxshi deb aytadi?
options: Because they would hear him shouting if he wasn't.
items.answer: Because they would hear him shouting if he wasn't.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'If he wasn't all right, we would hear him shouting!'

items.textEn: 6 Why did the python get away?
options: Because Sandra was standing too close.
items.answer: Because Sandra was standing too close.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Abou can't catch it if you stand there!' / 'Because of me, the python got away.'

items.textEn: 7 How does Abou feel at the end?
items.uz: 7 Abou oxirida o'zini qanday his qiladi?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Never mind ... we're lucky, too, because nobody was hurt.'
